observations: Photo 0 shows a black Casio keyboard on a black X-style stand, placed on a tiled floor. The model number 'CTK-495' is visible on the top right of the keyboard.
Photo 1 is a closer top-down view of the same keyboard, showing the control panel, display screen, and keys. The brand 'CASIO' is visible below the screen.
The keyboard appears to have some dust and minor smudges on the surface, especially on the control panel and screen area.
The keys are intact and show no visible cracks or discoloration.
The stand is metal and appears to be in good condition with no visible damage.
No power adapter is visible in the photos, though the seller claims it is available.

claims.claim: Neatly used Casio Keyboard CTK 495 working perfectly
claims.evidence: Photos show the keyboard's appearance but do not show it powered on or in use. No audio or video proof of functionality.

Photo 1 shows visible smudges and dust on the control panel and screen, which may indicate minor surface wear. While not deep scratches, the claim of 'no scratche' is not supported by the visual evidence.
No adapter is visible in either photo. The claim cannot be verified from the images alone.

risks.risk: Keyboard may not be functional or may have internal issues (e.g., dead keys, sound problems)
risks.proof: Video or photo of the keyboard powered on, playing notes, and showing the display working.

risks.risk: Adapter may not be included or may be damaged
risks.proof: Photo of the adapter and its plug, preferably connected to the keyboard.

risks.risk: Hidden scratches or damage not visible in photos (e.g., under keys, on back, or on stand)
risks.proof: Photo of the underside and back of the keyboard and stand.

proof_requests: Video or photo of the keyboard powered on and playing notes.
Photo of the adapter and its plug.
Photo of the underside and back of the keyboard and stand.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified as Casio CTK-495, but the seller's claims about it being 'working perfectly' and 'no scratche' are not supported by the photos. The adapter is also unverified. Without proof of functionality and condition, the item cannot be priced accurately.
